title: Buying several of an item charges for one
trap: The subtotal also decides free shipping, which must be right for multi-item orders.
issue: A customer added 3 mugs at $12.50 each. The receipt said `3 items, total $17.49`, but it should be `3 items, total $42.49` ($37.50 plus $4.99 shipping). Single items are charged correctly.
